result.stdout:
 ────────────────────────────
 AfricaStage Pit Seeder CLI
 ────────────────────────────
Commands:		seed, export, audit, delete-property, delete-item  
  pits seed <PitName> --source <file>  
  pits export (<PitName> | --wwwa) (--out-dir <dir> | --json)  
  pits audit <PitName> [--machine <all|local|name>] [--level <severity>] [--json]  
  pits delete-property <PitName> <ItemId> <PropertyPath>  
  pits delete-item <PitName> <ItemId>  
-h, --help		print out all options  
-v, --version		print version info  
-n, --nologo		do not display the banner  
-b, --debug		enable debug output  
-r, --pitroot		root directory containing pits  
-c, --cloud		no DefaultCloudOrder providers are configured  
-s, --source		source file for import (JSON or JSON5)  
-e, --export		export directory for JSON output  
--json			export to stdout (for piping to jq, grep, etc.)  
--wwwa			operate on all 4 pits (Person, Object, Place, Activity)  
--retain-window		keep this CLI process activity window until its normal timeout  
 Legacy		flat seed/export flags remain supported in 4.x; use command syntax before 5.x  
 PitName		pit to operate on or seed target (e.g., Activity)  
			positional arg: pit to operate on, or target pit name when used with -s  
			e.g. 'pits -s patch.json5 -r <root> Activity' seeds Activity.pit from patch.json5  
 Person		Person.pit  
 Object		Object.pit  
 Place			Place.pit  
 Activity		Activity.pit
